title.rendered: Multipurpose Sling Duffle Bag – Convertible to Backpack by Castilo Milano

content.rendered:
Multipurpose Sling Duffle Bag | Convertible to backpack | Dual tone finish | Separate laptop space

– Unique 2 in 1 design with dual tone finish
– Full size duffle bag, can be converted to a Laptop backpack
– Spacious design with outside pocket
– Can be used as an overnighter
– Use as a duffle, sling bag or a backpack
– Laptop pockets holds up to 15″ laptop Backpack
– Concealed separate pocket for shoes, dirty laundry etc.
– Durable construction
